story_position: Chapter 1 — Beat 11 — Hollow Watch Resolution / Torren Recruitment
scene_purpose: Resolve the condition that kept Torren Harth in Greenhollow, convert him from temporary ally to permanent party member without a ceremonial recruitment speech, and return the journey to the southern Briar route. Torren's commitment should arise because the Hollow Watch garrison's fate is now known, the immediate occupation/ancient-defense threat has been cleared enough for him to leave, and Maevra's original request for his route expertise can now honestly be accepted.

sections: Beat 11 — Hollow Watch Resolution / Torren Recruitment

scene_context_seed.location_name: Hollow Watch surface / secured overlook before departure
visible_environment: Hollow Watch surface has been cleared of its immediate Black Host occupation
the dead garrison remains a real human cost and should not be forgotten during recruitment
the ancient lower structure remains below and unexplained
the protected mural has just given the party a reason to inspect the southern Wayfinder formation later
the practical route back toward Greenhollow/Briar is open
scene_context_seed.runtime_note: This is a stopped resolution scene, not walk-and-talk. Torren should not suddenly know more about the mural or ancient infrastructure than he did in Beat 10. He knows only that modern Wayfinder matches a prominent landform in the mural and lies near the southern travel line. His recruitment should be understated and adult: Maevra originally came for him; in Greenhollow he could not honestly leave while Hollow Watch was unresolved; now he can. Avoid gamey phrases such as 'join the party,' destiny speeches, instant found-family declarations, or promises that he knows the whole southern route. Permanent-party state is a gameplay/story lock, but his spoken commitment can remain practical: he is coming with them toward Caelora and will guide the southern Briar route using current ground truth.
